title: S&P 500 rejects SpaceX, also blocking entry for OpenAI and Anthropic
summary: The S&P 500 index has rejected SpaceX's attempt for accelerated entry and will not waive its profitability rules to include unprofitable AI companies like OpenAI and Anthropic, creating barriers for investors seeking exposure to leading AI and space technology companies through standard index funds.
problem_solved: Addresses the question of whether major stock indices should include highly valuable but unprofitable technology companies.
why_valuable: Determines how retail and institutional investors can access exposure to the most valuable AI and space companies through mainstream investment vehicles.
